about_the_game:
Your peaceful vacation takes a sharp turn when your GPS reroutes you through The Nowhere Trail, a forgotten stretch of backcountry filled with sinkholes, gas leaks, and strange locals who don’t take kindly to outsiders.

Grab your friends, pile into your trusty van, and set off on an off-road survival comedy where everything from your suspension to your friendships will be tested.

🛠️ Key Features

  • Co-Op Chaos (1–4 Players)
    Drive, repair, navigate, and bicker your way to safety. One player steers while others manage tools, winches, snacks, and sanity.

  • Dynamic Terrain & Physics
    Every rock, rut, and muddy slope reacts realistically. Pull, push, or tow your way out or sink trying.

  • Survival on the Road
    Manage fuel, food, and morale. Cook at campfires, patch leaks, share water… or steal your friend’s last energy bar.

  • Weather & Time Systems
    Rain, fog, and nightfall can change the journey dramatically. Plan routes and watch your headlights, you never know what’s lurking on the roadside.

  • Randomized Routes
    Each playthrough generates a new map layout, events, and hazards for endless replayability.

  • Proximity Chat & Roleplay
    Yell instructions (or insults) that only nearby players can hear for truly authentic chaos.

  • Mystery Encounters
    Meet strange travelers, uncover roadside shrines, and discover why the Nowhere Trail was closed off in the first place...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 TI
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X / Intel Core i7-9700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Survive the world’s most chaotic road trip! Team up with friends to drive, repair, and argue your way through treacherous terrain, unpredictable weather, and mysterious small towns in a physics-driven co-op adventure.
